title: Examples Manifest
description: Maps example test files to their test run URLs for documentation embedding

url.description: Full URL to the test run (legacy source for testcase ID)

replayUrl.description: Public replay URL with share key

embedUrl.description: Public replay embed URL used by docs iframes

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of when this URL was last updated

title.description: Human-readable title extracted from describe() block

testName.description: Test name extracted from it() block
